description: Original prototype c/n 00 built from an IA-35 airframe, on charge with the CEV February 1962 (LQ-HER, LV-X27, TX-01, TX-110, LQ-AMC, T-110, TX-01), the Antarctic explorer of 1968; retired 15 October 1994 and displayed with the false serial T-121 in II Brigada scheme. Photographed February 2019.
